reviewed_distinct.reason: Same CIS Benchmark methodology, different operating systems. The controls, tooling and audit commands do not overlap, so both must exist; each description must name the OS explicitly and point at the other.

Both do file integrity monitoring, but one is a multi-tool HIDS procedure (OSSEC, Wazuh, AIDE; FIM plus syscall/config auditing across platforms) and the other is the AIDE-only Linux FIM workflow (baseline DB, cron checks). Each description names its scope and points at the other.
